comment: Two controls were proved dead by reading the code. The ARM input sets a flag that only lights the arm lamp and is cleared by the next toggle; nothing else reads it. The RETURN button toggles the return lamp, and the variable holding its state is computed and never used, so the return path is taken from whether a cable is patched. Both main outputs carry the wrong tooltip: configOutput is called a second time on them with the names Clock and Phase, which belong to the two small jacks at the bottom. An undo button, an undo CV input and a return modulation input are declared with no widget.
